data.name: Fire Bolt
data.description: As a standard action, you can unleash a scorching bolt of divine fire from your hand. You can target any single foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack with this bolt of fire. If you hit the foe, the fire bolt deals 1d6 points of fire damage. You can use this ability %1 times per day.|FireBoltTimes|PREVARLT:DomainFireLVL,2
